qAndA.question: What does Cardy B plan to do with her parents when they reach a certain age?

qAndA.answer: She believes that the food in America is not organic and leads to health problems, forcing people to take multiple medications. She supports this view by comparing the shorter lifespans of Americans with those in island countries like the Dominican Republic, where people consume fresh, natural food.

qAndA.answer: She wants them to eat real organic chicken that they raise themselves and vegetables that they grow, symbolizing a healthier and more natural lifestyle.

narrativeProgression.description: Cardy B talks about her plans for the future to move her parents to the islands after they reach a certain age.
She expresses concern about the food quality in the US and believes it's unhealthy.
She emphasizes her desire to move her parents out of the US and have them experience a healthier lifestyle where they can eat fresh food.
Cardy B shares examples of her grandparents who lived longer lives because they spent time in the Dominican Republic, where they had access to fresh, natural food.
She talks about her experience with frequent headaches and digestive issues after eating processed foods and taking medication, further solidifying her belief in the unhealthy nature of US food.
Cardy B reveals her plan to move her parents out of the US and encourage them to adopt a healthier lifestyle, slaughtering their own chicken and eating fresh vegetables.
She continues to express concern about the unhealthy lifestyles in the US, mentioning people who are vegan or only eat greens but still experience health issues.
She contrasts this with her experience in the Dominican Republic, where people have longer and healthier lives.
Cardy B reiterates her intention to move her parents out of the US and her belief in the importance of eating fresh food.
